highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bundles Skia milestone m151 and ports several hot paths to managed code for speed.
highlights_body: Colour conversion, premultiplication, and HarfBuzz text-shaping helpers move from native round-trips to allocation-free managed implementations, and WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 support for .NET 11.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151 and merges several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes.

bullets.lead: SKColor, SKColorF, and premultiply conversions ported to managed code
bullets.detail: SKColor<->SKColorF conversion and single-value premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer/float math instead of calling into native Skia, and gain new ReadOnlySpan<char> hex-parsing overloads.
Buffer.AddUtf8(string), Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads avoid per-call allocations and native round-trips.

bullets.lead: WASM adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11
bullets.detail: New native WASM assets let .NET 11 apps build against Emscripten 5.0.6, and a preview-.NET WASM test job catches exception-handling regressions.

bullets.lead: Fixed a native resource leak decoding subset images
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the underlying native resource on each call.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Cross-backend golden-image test harness and Skia submodule maintenance.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 submodule bump and the SKColor/premultiply managed-port work.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the HarfBuzzSharp allocation-free shaping fixes and further upstream m151 bug-fix merges.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 rolled in the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 assets and the SKImage native resource leak fix ahead of stable.

harfbuzz_summary: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag.Parse now avoid per-call allocations, and the bundled HarfBuzz updates to 14.2.1.
